consentListResponse.description: List of consent states for the authenticated user

ConsentState.description: Represents the current state of a consent for a specific user

name.description: The unique name/identifier of the consent

scope.description: The scope of the consent, eg global or admin_user. 'global' means the consent applies to all users, 'admin_user' means the consent applies to the authenticated user only

identifier.description: The user identifier for whom this consent state applies, if the scope is not global

status.description: The current state of the consent. 'requested' means the user has not yet responded, 'accepted' means the user granted consent, 'revoked' means the user withdrew consent

actorId.description: The user identifier of who performed the consent action, eg for global consents, it it user who accepted/revoked it
